facts.big: The bill has to be paid by Friday
facts.label: have to com o passivo
facts.sub: Use has/have to be + particípio para regras e prazos: The bill has to be paid, the receipts have to be saved.

facts.label: tem que ser + particípio
facts.sub: Use has to be + particípio para dizer o que deve ser feito com uma coisa: The bill has to be paid. The transfer has to be approved. Não diz quem faz a ação.

compare.ask: The bill has to be paid by Friday.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “a conta tem que ser paga até sexta”.
compare.tip: Diga: “The bill has to be paid by Friday.”
compare.us: Em inglês, use have/has to + be + particípio: The bill has to be paid. The receipts have to be saved. Use by + data para o prazo: by Friday. Na pergunta, use Does/Do + sujeito + have to be + particípio.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.

items.s: The bill has to be paid means someone must pay it.

items.why: We use have to be with plural things and has to be with one thing.

pages.title: Bills at an office in Halifax · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a windy Wednesday in Halifax. Kai and Rui work in a small office near the harbour. There are papers and bills on the desk. A reminder is open on the screen. Friday is only two days away. They have to organize everything today.

“Rui, did you see the reminder? The electricity bill has to be paid by Friday.” says Kai. “I saw it. The invoice for the internet has to be paid by the same day.” says Rui. “What happens if it isn’t paid on time? Is there a penalty?” says Kai.

pages.title: Bills at an office in Halifax · 3/3
paragraphs: “Only the big ones have to be approved. Small bills are paid by me.” says Rui. “Perfect. I’ll ask the manager now, so everything is done by Friday.” says Kai. Rui writes the dates on a big calendar. Kai sends a message to the manager. The first bill is approved in ten minutes. Rui saves every receipt in a folder. Both men feel calm again. Good plans keep bills from becoming problems.
